summary: The Source control refspec field sets extra git refs a project update fetches, for example refs/*:refs/remotes/origin/* or refs/pull/*:refs/remotes/origin/pull/* for GitHub pull requests; blank fetches only refs/heads/, and the refspec decides which branch overrides are available.
questions: How do I fetch GitHub pull request refs in an AAP project?
What is the Source control refspec field?
What refs does the git module fetch by default in controller?
How do I run a job against a pull request branch?

answer_card.title: Fetch extra git refs with a refspec
answer_card.answer_md:
Set the project's **Source control refspec** to fetch refs beyond `refs/heads/`:

- `refs/*:refs/remotes/origin/*`: all references
- `refs/pull/*:refs/remotes/origin/pull/*`: all GitHub pull requests
- `refs/pull/62/head:refs/remotes/origin/pull/62/head`: one pull request

The first two can be slow on large repositories. Each project update runs an extra `git fetch` for the refspec, and the refspec decides which values can be used as a *Source control branch* override.
